name: Add diagonal bracing
expectedBenefit: Reduces lateral sway and improves frame stability by replacing the no-brace assembly with a defined diagonal-bracing assembly.
notes: Engineering capacity remains unverified until member and connection properties are validated.

name: Add roof tie-down straps
expectedBenefit: Improves the roof-to-frame restraint path by replacing the standard restraint assembly with the defined tie-down strap assembly.
notes: Uplift capacity is unverified and must not be inferred from the assembly name.

name: Upgrade frame size
expectedBenefit: Changes the frame assembly from the A0 25x25 mm tube option to the defined 38x38 mm tube option for controlled comparison.
notes: Section thickness and engineering properties remain subject to verification in the product library.

name: Use thicker wall backing
expectedBenefit: Changes the wall-backing assembly from 6 mm FCB to the defined 9 mm FCB alternative without changing the separate outer cladding layer.
notes: This is an assembly substitution for comparison, not a verified claim that 9 mm backing resolves the failure mode.

name: Improve screw spacing
expectedBenefit: Intended to improve load distribution at panel connections.
notes: Blocked until panel-connection geometry, fastener count/spacing, and connection capacities are represented explicitly.
The legacy Phase 1 fixed peso modifier is not accepted as a Phase 2 engineering/cost definition.

name: Add positive base anchorage
expectedBenefit: Intended to improve the post/base-to-foundation load path against uplift, sliding, and overturning demand.
notes: Blocked until base connection is separated from generic connection data and an explicit anchor/pedestal assembly is defined.
